articles.title: Trevor Rogers praises Orioles but will ‘test the market’ in free agency
articles.description: Rogers’ performance will make him one of the better starting pitchers on a free agent market that is weaker than most years.

articles.title: Orioles fall to Yankees, 6-3, to suffer 2nd straight losing season
articles.description: Brandon Young delivered a solid start, but the rest of the team fell short as Baltimore dropped to 79-82 in perhaps its final game of the season.

articles.title: Orioles’ Alonso blasts 2 homers to take AL lead in 10-2 win over Yankees
articles.description: The star first baseman will likely end the year leading the AL in two of three Triple Crown categories thanks to a strong finish.

articles.title: Orioles eliminated from playoff contention after White Sox win
articles.description: A win by the White Sox on Thursday means that the Orioles won’t even get the chance to fight for their playoff lives this weekend.

articles.title: Orioles top Blue Jays, 4-2, to sweep doubleheader, remain in playoff race
articles.description: The Orioles beat the Blue Jays, 4-2, on Wednesday in the second game of a doubleheader. Baltimore swept Toronto this week.

articles.title: Orioles beat Blue Jays, 4-2, stave off elimination to open doubleheader
articles.description: Pete Alonso hit his 41st home run of the season, and Chris Bassitt shut down his old team to keep the Orioles’ faint playoff hopes alive.

articles.title: 3 takeaways: Orioles and Ravens team up to give fans a forgettable Sunday
articles.description: Baltimore fans received yet another fourth-quarter collapse from the Ravens and a lifeless loss from the Orioles on Sunday.

articles.title: Orioles-Blue Jays game Tuesday postponed; split doubleheader Wednesday
articles.description: The Orioles and Blue Jays won’t play Tuesday night at Camden Yards because of inclement weather, pivoting to a doubleheader Wednesday.

articles.title: Orioles reinstate Bautista, shut down Helsley, option Kjerstad
articles.description: The Orioles reinstated right-hander Félix Bautista from the 60-day injured list Saturday. However, closer Ryan Helsley was also shut down with the elbow injury that forced him to the IL.

articles.title: Orioles’ playoff hopes dim despite Rogers’ gem in 1-0 loss to Brewers
articles.description: Rogers’ resplendent performance in his potential sendoff wasn’t enough, as the Orioles’ offense once again struggled in clutch situations.

articles.title: Pete Alonso’s 40th home run lifts Orioles past Blue Jays, 4-3, ends 3-game skid
articles.description: Pete Alonso homered twice, including a go-ahead two-run shot in the eighth inning, as the Orioles beat the Blue Jays on Monday, 4-3.
